sections.content:
Key finding: UP carried N and b (rows 19-22→13-16) but R stayed put (rows 19-22). So the beam only carries squares **to the LEFT of its tip** (tip ~col 28): N (18-21) and b (24-27) are left of tip → carried; R (30-33) is right of tip → stationary. This is the decoupling mechanism I need.
Now testing RIGHT (extend beam): tip should move to ~34, putting R left of tip. Carried squares shouldn't move on extension.
